one_liner: Shopify offers a broad GraphQL (plus legacy REST) Admin API with self-serve OAuth apps and free dev stores; ready to build, and the vendor publishes an official Shopify MCP for store management plus a dev-docs MCP.
auth_notes: Authorization code grant, token exchange and client credentials are supported for apps. Admin-created custom apps give a static shpat_ token. Public apps use the OAuth authorization-code flow. Tokens are sent in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header.
access_notes: A free Partner account / Dev Dashboard provides free development stores for sandbox testing. API access has no extra charge. Some APIs and scopes need Shopify approval (e.g. subscriptions/pre-order access requests, protected customer data), but core development is unblocked.
blocker_notes: Some scopes and APIs need Shopify approval, but core development and testing are unblocked.

evidence.quote: Authorization Code Grant Flow - Suitable for non-embedded apps - Installations, and access scope changes are managed by the app
Copy the **Admin API access token** shown once after installation
Next, create a **development store**. It’s free and sandboxed. You can test API calls without touching real orders or customer data.
Shopify does not charge extra for API usage. However, API rate limits apply (REST and GraphQL), and the limits vary by the store’s Shopify plan.
Some APIs also require Shopify's approval or a specific [Shopify plan](https://www.shopify.com/pricing).
[GraphQL Admin API](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/admin-graphql) reads and writes products, customers, orders, inventory, and the rest of the data behind the Shopify admin.
[Shopify MCP](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/shopify-mcp) lets merchants and partners set up and manage a store through the AI agent of their choice.
For agent skills and the Dev MCP server, see the [Shopify AI Toolkit](https://shopify.dev/docs/apps/build/ai-toolkit) page.
